bifrost: bifrost_app::defaults, coding, file_coordination, fswatch, workspace, quicksearch, document; docbroker file grants
summary: Settings, JSON, XML and binary plist coding, keyed archives with secure coding, FileWrapper, bookmarks, FileManager item operations with replaceItemAt and enumerators, file metadata queries, backup exclusion, file coordination, change events and Spotlight-style indexing have SDK APIs. No iCloud and no file versions.

features.feature: File System (create, read, write, examine files)
features.apple: FileManager, FileHandle, URL file APIs, FileWrapper, bookmarks
features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/docbroker.rs; docs/file-portal-design.md; springboard/sdk/src/document.rs; wired: springboard/apps/files/src/info.rs (get_info reads the item status for the panel); springboard/sdk/src/file_manager.rs (replace_item_at, enumerator, resource_values), springboard/sdk/src/file_wrapper.rs, springboard/sdk/src/bookmark.rs
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 37 tests (earlier part). Added later, host tests only: NativeFileManager has item operations, replaceItemAt (keeps permissions and xattrs, backup name), a directory enumerator with prefetched resource keys, and URLResourceKey values (name, size, dates, identifier, volume capacity incl. important usage). FileWrapper (regular/directory/symlink, matchesContents, atomic write with originalContents hard links) and bookmarks (inode+path resolution, stale flag, relative-to, cached resource values, security-scoped gate) are new. Host tests only (tests/files_persistence.rs); verify on Midget for parity. Gaps: bookmark scope is enforced by the API only, no network volumes, no file versions.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/file_coordination.rs; wired: springboard/apps/files/src/ops.rs (transfer_now, compress_now, extract_now) via src/coordinate.rs (writing_in, refused)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 3 tests. Advisory flock; no relinquish or move negotiation; versions live in file_version.rs. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.
Recursive inotify stream with latency and a SHALLOW flag.
Recycle uses the shared Recently Deleted folder with Put Back.

features.feature: Archives and Serialization: JSON and property lists
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 11 tests (earlier part). Added later, host tests only: JSON, XML plist and binary plist (bplist00 read and write: all int widths, real, date, data, ascii/utf-16 strings, uid, arrays, dicts; PropertyListEncoder.encode_binary and decode_binary). The Data type is Codable: base64 in JSON and XML, a data object in binary, tested headless in parity_sdk-complete-19.rs. Gap: only the ISO 8601 and seconds date strategies exist, and no data encoding strategies. Host tests only.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests (earlier part). Added later, host tests only: Pure model plus a binary form in the keyed-archive layout ($archiver, $version, $top, $objects, $class descriptions) and secure coding (requiresSecureCoding, decodeObject(of:forKey:) with a per-call class list). The archiver name is this system's own, so archives from other implementations are not read. Not wired into apps; host tests only.
Typed get/set and register(defaults:); no change-observation across processes noted.

One restorable window per app in one JSON file; restored state keeps Data fields and a broken file is discarded (headless tests in parity_sdk-complete-19.rs). Gap: the app hook takes one identifier, so several windows per app need a new hook and a shell change.

Per-app JSON index in the shell. The SDK checks identifiers before sending (IndexError) and sends items in chunks of at most MAX_ITEMS (8). Headless tests: sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01a.rs (an_indexed_item_needs_an_identifier_within_its_limits, a_search_over_the_app_items_finds_the_matching_title).

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 17 tests (earlier part). Host tests only: MetadataQuery over search scopes with predicates, gathering then update notifications through fswatch, MetadataItem attributes, disable and enable updates, and sort descriptors (ascending and descending by any attribute, ties broken by later keys then path, re-sorted when set on a running query). Still missing: grouping, a predicate text parser and content attributes, and the lab machine has not run these sorts.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 10 tests. Wave 3 (theme-01, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Apple iCloud service; BifrOSt Cloud backups/sync are separate and not an SDK file API.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/file_metadata.rs (xattr, set_excluded_from_backup, backup_items), springboard/sdk/src/file_manager.rs (IsExcludedFromBackup key), springboard/render/src/purgeable.rs; tests: springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-06.rs, springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-tests-06.rs
features.note: isExcludedFromBackup is stored as the user.bifrost.exclude-from-backup xattr: backup_items skips an excluded directory with its contents and never enters a symbolic link, and the file manager reports the flag as a resource value (a_backup_walk_lists_items..., an_excluded_directory_is_skipped..., the_file_manager_reports_the_backup_exclusion...). The purgeable Cache drops its oldest cost under pressure and on limits (a_partial_purge_drops_the_oldest_half...), tested headless in render/tests. Gap: no on-disk purgeable data, and the purge runs only on memory pressure in the process.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Per-app store keyed by device and inode (renames keep history); current, other (newest first), add, replace, remove, discardable pruning by count and age. No conflict or iCloud versions; verify on Midget.

gaps: Midget check of the new file APIs (all rows stay partial until then)
iCloud / cloud-synced documents and key-value store
Metadata query sort descriptors, grouping and predicate parser
